default_game_mode_settings.source: TurnTimerGameModeSettings::.ctor 0x06006316; bool PlayTickSound has no assignment and uses CLR false default. Mode overrides must be respected.

runtime_rules.birth: Birth -> State 5 waits 0.01 scaled seconds -> State 1. Opens and unravels start on State 1 entry, concurrently with its 0.87 real-time Wait, not after it.
runtime_rules.countdown: State 2 AudioPlaythroughAction sets codeVolume to RopeFuseVolume and plays the looping AudioSource. The following AudioVolumeFadeAction captures current codeVolume and targets RopeFuseVolume over 0.3 scaled seconds. There is no source command setting the start to zero; do not fabricate a 0->0.4 fade.
runtime_rules.stinger: State 2 FINISHED occurs after its fade action finishes. Play Stinger? tests PlayMusicStinger, then plays on the existing stinger source with codeVolume=1.0. Serialized source volume=0.699999988079071; code volume is a multiplier, not replacement of source volume.
runtime_rules.death: Death -> State 3 immediately stops stinger; fades burns current codeVolume to 0 over 0.1 scaled seconds, stops on completion; plays explodes and flips_over immediately at EndTurnButtonExplosionVolume. PlayTimeoutFx gates only the later Play Fx visual state, not these audio actions.
runtime_rules.cancel: Cancel -> State 4 immediately stops stinger; fades burns current codeVolume to 0 over 0.4 scaled seconds, stops on completion. No explosion/flip action in Cancel.
runtime_rules.tick: UpdateCountdownText only ticks when m_PlayTickSound is true and ceil(remaining) < m_lastTickSecondNumber. It updates last, uses tick for nonzero and final_tick at zero. StartCountdownAnims resets last to ceil(m_RopeCapSeconds), normally 20. Default settings disable ticks. The method also returns on absent GameState/game entity or game over.
runtime_rules.volume: SoundManager final volume = codeVolume * sourceVolume * SoundDef random volume * categoryVolume * duckingVolume. All eight SoundDefs random volume and pitch ranges are [1,1]. Fade interpolates codeVolume via Mathf.Lerp; it is not a dB fade.
runtime_rules.direct_clip_refs: AudioPlaythroughAction::Play uses m_OneShotSound when provided; legacy serialized m_OneShotClip is not read by this method in this build. Each clip ref and SoundDef GUID resolve to the same original asset for the three direct refs.

limitations: Source-only recovery, not original Unity execution or auditory/GPU/Android validation.
Five GUID-bound clips remain unavailable from local same-build sources; missing path IDs are null rather than invented.
Existing 2018 archive WAVs are evidence-only and are not accepted as same-build runtime fallback.
Global mix, category routing, ducking, spatialization, interruption scheduling and mode overrides still require integration verification.
